brunei.title: Flag of the Nation of Brunei, the Abode of Peace

colors.note: The royal colour of Brunei, representing the Sultan
Diagonal stripe representing the chief ministers of the sultanate
Diagonal stripe representing the chief ministers of the sultanate
The national emblem and crest at the centre

desc:
- Yellow field with two diagonal stripes of white and black and the national emblem in red at the centre
- The emblem shows a crescent, a parasol, wings, hands, and a scroll bearing the state motto

countryData.name: Brunei
countryData.officialName: Nation of Brunei, the Abode of Peace
countryData.location: north coast of Borneo, Southeast Asia

trivia:
- The Arabic motto on the scroll reads 'Always in service with God's guidance'
- The crescent stands for Islam, the state religion of Brunei
- The emblem was added in 1959, turning a simpler 1906 yellow-and-stripes banner into the current design
